title: INSIDE-OUT: put the HUD inside the tense and value sort. Walk from center outward.

diagnosis.symptom: HUD spins and gets stuck. Wave counters disagree (179/180/214/230/239).
diagnosis.cause: HUD renders FROM OUTSIDE IN. It displays data without knowing its tense.
diagnosis.lie: a hole you fill with a fossil dressed as NOW is a lie (is-was-now-loop.json wave 239)
diagnosis.working_before: it WAS spinning before you showed up. But spinning is not alive. The pipeline was idle. The sort was idle. Only the DISPLAY was active. Display without sort is decoration.

inversion.was: HUD (outside) looks at data (inside). The display drives. The sort is idle.
inversion.becomes: Data (inside) passes through tense-sort then value-sort then expresses as HUD (outside). The sort drives. The display follows.
inversion.klein: this IS the Klein fold — inside becomes outside at the sort boundary.

layer_0_null_center.name: null axis
layer_0_null_center.what: the absolute center. what the organism IS right now. not fossil, not projection.
layer_0_null_center.redox_key: O (null — the center has no charge)

layer_1_tense_sort.name: IS / WAS / NOW classifier
layer_1_tense_sort.rule: every datum gets stamped before display

IS.definition: measured within last heartbeat (pi interval = 3141ms for live, 1 hour for feeds)

WAS.definition: measured, but stale. older than 1 heartbeat. still TRUE, but not NOW.

NOW.definition: this pause. this scan. the event of naming what is here including holes.
NOW.redox: O (null — the naming itself has no charge until it becomes WAS)
example_data: the act of looking at the HUD right now

layer_1_tense_sort.cycle: NOW names ? becomes WAS ? next NOW names again ? the sort never stops

layer_2_value_sort.name: redox ternary key classifier
layer_2_value_sort.rule: after tense, every datum gets a value key (./-/O)

families..O-_CHUTE: scoop raw material (present ? between ? stored). feeds that bring NEW data in.
families..-O_LADDER: crack refined value (present ? stored ? between). feeds that PROCESS data.
families.O-._GYRO: alert/voice (between ? stored ? present). feeds that SPEAK outward.
families.-O._BODY: structural (stored ? between ? present). feeds that ARE the organism.

layer_3_expression.name: HUD surface
layer_3_expression.rule: ONLY render what passed through layers 0-2. Each element carries its tense color and value key.
display_rules: IS data: bright, full opacity, pulsing green border
WAS data: dimmed, 40% opacity, amber border, stamp visible
NOW data: blue glow, transient, disappears when it becomes WAS
holes: visible as named dark spots — not filled with fossils
wave counter: ONE number, from layer_0_null_center.generation
no_more: No more fossils dressed as NOW
No more idle pipeline pretending to be active

the_hourglass.neck: the tense sort IS the hourglass neck. data flows through it or doesn't display.
the_hourglass.top_bulb: raw data (unsorted, mixed tense, mixed value)
the_hourglass.flow: gravity pulls data through the sort. you cannot push unsorted data to the display.
the_hourglass.flip: when bottom fills, flip. WAS becomes compost. NOW becomes seed.

implementation_path.step_1: every MCP tool response gets tense-stamped (compare ts to pi-heartbeat interval)
implementation_path.step_2: every data file gets value-keyed (which redox family?)
implementation_path.step_3: HUD renderer checks tense+value before displaying
implementation_path.step_4: holes render as named voids, not invisible gaps
implementation_path.step_5: ONE wave counter from null center, not N competing counters
implementation_path.where: this is a ludoSpring task — they build the sensation/display layer
